top_categories.workout_context: 78 miles on mountain passes burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
121ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Granfondo La Guadeloupe's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before December.
At Granfondo La Guadeloupe, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.

Road-specific control matters at Granfondo La Guadeloupe. Practice on mountain passes: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 78 miles.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Granfondo La Guadeloupe. Train it until it feels boring.
9,459ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.

race_overlay.heat: December in Capesterre-Belle-Eau, Guadeloupe can bring heat. Complete 3–4 heat exposure sessions in the final 2 weeks before Granfondo La Guadeloupe. Increase sodium intake 48 hours before race day.
race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for Granfondo La Guadeloupe's 78 miles. Start early and use products you tolerate. The organizer has not published a reliable resupply plan, so rehearse a self-sufficient carry and revise it when the rider document is released.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at Granfondo La Guadeloupe. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Granfondo La Guadeloupe rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on mountain passes to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, TT Threshold, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 78 miles of mountain passes in Capesterre-Belle-Eau, Guadeloupe.
